lines.sub: You assign something in a chat — and forget. Done or not? Who knows.

lines.sub: Tell me: “Assign Olga to update the price list by Friday.”
lines.tts: Tell me: Assign Olga to update the price list by Friday.

lines.sub: Olga gets the assignment — in Telegram, MAX or the Dewiar app.

lines.sub: Olga taps “I'll take it”. Done — “Done”, with a photo.

lines.sub: Can't make it — “Postpone”, with a reason.

lines.sub: And you get a board: who took what, what's done, who's past the deadline.

lines.sub: Or send it back with a remark — Olga sees it right away.
